adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `blacklistedGuestEmails` are lowercased (`split(...).map(email => email.toLowerCase())`), but the incoming `guests` values are compared without normalization: `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` and `!booking.attendees.some(attendee => guest === attendee.email)`. Since `guest` is not lowercased, a mixed-case email like `Foo@x.com` can bypass both the blacklist check and the existing-attendee dedupe (both are strict, case-sensitive comparisons). This is verifiable directly from the diff and can lead to adding blacklisted/duplicate emails.
